# Format properties: Line and area charts

> **Applies to:** Creators · Developers

Every card and property the Format pane offers for the visuals on this page (Line chart, Area chart, Stacked area chart, 100% stacked area chart), generated from the visual definitions in the code. For how to use the Format pane, see [Format a visual](../../create-reports/format-a-visual.md); for what these visuals do, see [the visual article](../../visuals/line-and-area-charts.md).

The cards on the **General** tab that every visual shares (title, effects, header icons, tooltips, alt text) are listed once in [General tab](general-tab.md).

| Visual | PBIR type | Visual-tab cards | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|
| Line chart | `lineChart` | 13 | 179 |
| Area chart | `areaChart` | 13 | 179 |
| Stacked area chart | `stackedAreaChart` | 11 | 141 |
| 100% stacked area chart | `hundredPercentStackedAreaChart` | 10 | 133 |
